messages:
Sara K: Hey team — customer Acme reports they can't accept a project invite in the Console. They click the link, get a 403 and a snackbar: 'Permission denied (project.view)'. Happens for two users in the same IdP group. They say this started after a group rename yesterday. Screenshot: https://acme.s3/console-403.png :eyes:
Jess - Support: Thanks Sara. Can you paste the full error payload from the browser console or the API call? Also which project and org?
Sara K: Project: acme-data-prod (proj-5467), Org: Acme Corp (org-332). Browser console shows POST /api/v1/projects/proj-5467/invite/accept -> 403 {"error":"forbidden","reason":"missing_scope","missing":"project.view"} . User is claiming SAML groups: ["acme-users","acme-project-admins-v2"] according to customer.
Alejandro (IDP): @Sara can you share the SAML assertion (redact PII) or the group SAML attribute values? Also when you say group rename, did SCIM sync run after the rename? :thinking_face:
Sara K: Customer shared SAML assertion (attached to ticket). Assertion lists groups: acme-users and acme-admins (note: customer says they renamed acme-project-admins-v2 -> acme-admins). SCIM sync log last run 2024-11-02T02:10Z (idp-sync-bot).
idp-sync-bot: SCIM delta detected: group acme-project-admins-v2 -> acme-admins (rename). Members preserved: 120 users. Sync status: COMPLETED with warnings (mapping-rule-not-found).
Mike - SRE: That warning is suspicious — mapping-rule-not-found usually means our org's role mapping references the old group name. Can you check org role-mapping for Acme?
Sara K: Checking org role mappings: In org settings, role mapping for 'project-admin' has condition group == 'acme-project-admins-v2'. There's no mapping for 'acme-admins'. So renamed group won't match.
Jess - Support: Ok that explains missing role in the Console. Two users got SAML assertion with acme-admins but our mapping still looks for old name -> mapped role not applied -> 403. Quick workaround: add a temporary mapping or add users manually as project-admins. Customer prefers automated fix.
Alejandro (IDP): We can either update the mapping to the new group name or add an alias. Before changing mapping, confirm no other downstream groups depend on the old name. Also check audit trail to confirm when the mapping was last edited.
Sara K: Audit shows mapping last edited 2023-09-10 by product-ops. I'll propose to update mapping to match acme-admins. Customer gave permission for us to update.
Mike - SRE: Two caveats — if we update mapping, any policy that references the old group name elsewhere could break. Suggest we add a second condition (group == 'acme-admins' OR group == 'acme-project-admins-v2') and keep for 7 days, then remove old. Any objections? :thumbsup:
Jess - Support: Good plan. I'll patch mapping and note change in ticket. Sara can you trigger a manual SCIM full sync after mapping change to ensure role applies immediately?
Sara K: On it. Patch applied at 2024-11-04T14:08Z: added OR condition. Triggering SCIM full sync now.
idp-sync-bot: Full SCIM sync started by Sara K at 2024-11-04T14:09Z. Status: COMPLETED. 2 users newly updated with role project-admin.
Acme Admin: Confirming — can now accept invite and access project. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
Jess - Support: Great. I'll leave mapping with both names for 7 days and schedule a reminder to remove the old name. Also documenting root cause: IdP group rename without updating Redwood org role mapping -> mapping-rule-not-found during SCIM -> missing project role -> 403 on invite accept.
Alejandro (IDP): For long-term mitigation, recommend using group external IDs or a canonical attribute that survives renames, and also add a small validator in the Console that warns when SCIM reports mapping-rule-not-found. I'll open a ticket.
Mike - SRE: Logging verdict: no runtime bug, policy config drift. Closing with workaround and clean-up plan.
Sara K: Closing ticket after verification from customer at 2024-11-04T14:15Z. Notes saved to ticket: mapping updated, full sync run, monitor for 7 days. :lock:
